title: Ochre Stage Tailoring — warm studio, low camera, wide tailoring in movement
compatibility: Any approved product subject; low-camera standing, balancing or seated coverage; broad structured tailoring and real free layers.
unknowns: whether the deep field is a cyclorama, curtain or open stage
exact light source type and distance
exact focus distance, focal length, grain and diffusion process

runtime_style.visual_system: Warm theatrical tailoring photography built from a low upward camera, a deep olive-to-ochre stage, one hard patterned side light, broad cloth masses, a bentwood chair and rust spheres used as spatial devices.
runtime_style.mood_line: Controlled theatre: the approved subject balances, reaches or sits inside a warm beam while tailoring falls in deliberate weighted planes.
runtime_style.environment: An original non-identifiable studio stage combining a deep olive field, pale floor strip, warm plaster plane, one bentwood chair, patterned window-like light and a few rust-orange spheres including one optional near-lens blur.
runtime_style.lighting: One hard warm source from a consistent side axis creates crisp patterned wall bands, narrow hot edges and a decisive floor shadow; the surrounding stage falls quickly into deep olive-brown with no fill glamour.
materials: dark olive stage field and pale matte floor
warm plaster-like wall carrying rounded rectangular light bands
bentwood chair used as a simple geometric prop
rust-orange spheres used at floor scale or as a defocused foreground mass
approved structured cloth holding broad folds and approved light layers hanging plumb
runtime_style.contrast: High theatrical warm contrast with black-brown anchors, olive field mids, terracotta accents, restrained saturation outside the beam and a gentle roll into #EFEFF0 window highlights.
runtime_style.expression_signature: Eyes lowered or tracking the active hand rather than performing to camera, upper lids low, brows and cheekbones at rest, mouth closed, jaw relaxed and chin tipped toward the gesture; no smile or raised-brow drama.
runtime_style.garment_behaviour: Still air: broad approved tailoring moves as weighted masses around knees and hips; real structural folds hold, lighter free layers hang plumb, and no material balloons or becomes falsely sheer.
optical_signature: Every frame uses clean warm rendering with restrained fine texture, no flare, no chromatic fringe and no global halation.
The camera remains low enough to lengthen the standing body or enlarge seated knees without naming a focal length.
Softness comes only from depth separation on a real near sphere, far stage plane or moving free edge; the approved subject remains materially crisp.

clean_identity_hero.camera_consequence: Vertical close portrait from below shoulder height against a sunlit ochre wall plane, with the face large and the upward camera consequence restrained.
clean_identity_hero.pose_joint_chain: Torso turns slight three-quarter, shoulders stay low, neck lengthens, head pans away, chin lowers and one quiet hand remains below the face crop.
clean_identity_hero.focus: Approved face, lowered eye plane and near collar or shoulder sharp; patterned wall light softens behind.
clean_identity_hero.foreground: No separate lens occluder; the near shoulder is the closest plane.
provenance: male-02-chair-taupe.png plus sheet-expression_gaze.png — face/light authority; authored clean-identity crop inside the approved universe

environmental_hero.camera_consequence: Vertical full-length low stage frame with the subject held between deep olive field, pale floor and a sparse rhythm of small terracotta spheres.
environmental_hero.pose_joint_chain: Support leg nearly straight, free knee crossing softly forward, pelvis shifted over support, torso leaning into one extended arm and opposite arm dropping beside body.
environmental_hero.focus: Approved subject sharp head to foot; far stage remains smooth and small floor spheres stay readable.
environmental_hero.foreground: A dark soft floor-edge band establishes the near plane without covering either foot.
provenance: male-04.png plus sheet-camera_lens.png — primary low standing consequence and stage depth authority

sculptural_three_quarter.camera_consequence: Extreme low vertical three-quarter composition; the near hip and broad lower tailoring enlarge while the torso rises diagonally through the hard beam.
sculptural_three_quarter.pose_joint_chain: Pelvis rotates three-quarter, one knee bends across support, spine lengthens, active shoulder abducts, elbow nearly extends, wrist releases and fingers curl toward the light.
sculptural_three_quarter.focus: Approved face, torso and dominant trouser fold sharp; far hand and stage edge soften modestly.
sculptural_three_quarter.foreground: The near hip and broad approved fold form the closest planes with no unrelated prop.
provenance: male-04.png and sheet-blocking.png — observed balance and reach chain expanded into the sculptural slot

interference_frame.camera_consequence: Low vertical medium portrait through one very large defocused terracotta sphere entering from the upper corner.
interference_frame.pose_joint_chain: Weight remains on one leg, torso angles beneath the sphere, one arm reaches across frame, opposite elbow drops and chin follows the active wrist.
interference_frame.focus: Approved face, reaching hand and central torso sharp; the near sphere dissolves into a soft colour mass.
interference_frame.foreground: One rust-orange sphere consumes roughly one quarter of an upper corner without touching the visible eye plane.
provenance: male-04.png plus sheet-camera_lens.png — observed sphere occlusion and clean depth-separated optic

material_or_accessory_detail.camera_consequence: Vertical waist-to-shoulder low detail with a hand controlling a broad approved fold or real accessory while body context remains attached.
material_or_accessory_detail.pose_joint_chain: Shoulder lowers, elbow bends across the waist, wrist turns the approved material toward the warm side light and fingers gather without crushing its real structure.
material_or_accessory_detail.focus: Approved weave, fold ridge, hand and wrist sharp; face remains visible but secondary.
material_or_accessory_detail.foreground: The attached hand and approved material fill the near lower plane; no flat lay and no detached product crop.
provenance: sheet-garment_behaviour.png — approved broad-fold, pleat-memory and plumb-layer authority translated into human-context detail

wide_campaign_coda.camera_consequence: Horizontal low-to-level stage wide with the subject at least thirty percent of frame height, one bentwood chair and a large patterned light pool defining the set.
wide_campaign_coda.pose_joint_chain: Pelvis sits or leans against the chair, one knee opens, opposite leg extends, one forearm rests across the chair back and the other hand drops loosely as head looks away.
wide_campaign_coda.focus: Approved subject and chair sharp; wall bands and dark stage perimeter remain readable with mild depth falloff.
wide_campaign_coda.foreground: A clean dark floor band and one small sphere may enter low frame without hiding the human chain.
provenance: male-02-chair-taupe.png plus sheet-environment.png — chair, warm wall and patterned-light authority for the authored campaign coda
